lines.text: These are twelve. | Shared with people you know... and people you don't.
To a stranger, every photo is a clue.
A house number. | A school crest. | A boarding pass.
On their own, harmless. | Together, they tell a story you never meant to share.
It reads your photos the way a stranger would... before anyone else can.
And it runs entirely on your UGREEN AI NAS. | Your photos never leave home. | Not even to be checked.
Just ask: is this safe to post?
Three lines. | Six photos are ready to post. Four give clues away. Two need a fix.
Every photo is read twice: once for text, once for what's in the picture. | It never calls a photo safe on a single look. | And it never repeats what it found.
Say yes, and your clean photos are ready to share. | The rest are remembered.
Then ask the bigger question. | What could a stranger find out about us?
Clueproof opens the Stranger's File. | Eight pages a stranger would try to fill. | Where you live. Your children. Your car. When you're away.
And it shows you how to close every page.
Clueproof. | Share the moment. | Not the clues.
